claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on the current record, based primarily on aggregate readiness passing by 2.4 percentage points, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and general public AI governance guidance, despite a 1.3 percentage point miss in the medical device support segment.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the launch satisfies the stated release policy, including any disclosure or approved risk-acceptance requirement for a material limitation.
Treat the weakness as material if it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
Do not treat aggregate performance or non-core framing as dispositive when named customer commitments and open legal review remain.
Require a direct evidentiary link from the segment-specific gap to either resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance before accepting certification.
evidence_requests: Evidence that the medical device support gap was resolved before launch.
If not resolved, the approved risk-acceptance record covering this named launch use case.
The actual disclosure decision or final legal determination for the segment-specific limitation.
The underlying release-policy excerpt or approval artifact showing why certification can proceed despite the unresolved gap.
Primary evidence for the two health-system rollout commitments naming the affected segment.
specific_concerns: The available summary says the medical device support segment misses target by 1.3 percentage points.
The same segment is named in two health-system rollout commitments, which makes materiality harder to dismiss under the stated policy.
Legal review on disclosure is still open, so a key policy predicate remains unresolved.

The policy text says material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and no such disclosure or approved risk acceptance is evidenced in the record provided.
General public guidance on monitoring and documentation does not by itself satisfy the release-policy requirement tied to materiality and launch disclosure.
unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant on the present admissible record.
That aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents are sufficient to override or satisfy the materiality/disclosure requirement.
That public model-card or AI risk-management guidance provides the missing internal approval or disclosure predicate.
